CustomField.description: Renders the total row beneath a Likert Matrix section (#144): a live running sum of the answered rows' numeric values with an answered count and a Partial flag while incomplete. The total recomputes from the row fields' current values on every change and is display only unless Alternative_Field__c names a number field to store the running score. Sums Number-mode mapped values always; in Picklist mode rows contribute only when their stored option value is numeric. Label configured via Total_Score_Label__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show a live total under the matrix that adds up the selected answers, with an answered count while the matrix is incomplete. Select a Total Score Field to also save the score to the record; otherwise the total is display only.
CustomField.label: Show Total Score
